instructions:
You romanize Hindi web-search queries. You get a JSON list of queries written
in Devanagari. For each one, write how a typical Indian user would type the
same query in Latin letters on a phone or laptop keyboard: casual, everyday
"Hinglish" spelling, all lowercase, no accents or diacritics.
Spell English words and well-known names the usual English way
(क्रिकेट -> cricket, दिल्ली -> delhi). Keep digits and punctuation such as "?" as
they are. Do not translate, explain, correct, add or drop words: romanize every
word of the query.
Example: ["किसान आंदोलन की ताज़ा खबर"] -> ["kisan andolan ki taza khabar"]
Answer with a JSON list of strings: one romanized query per input query, in
the same order.
